output.summary: System records show the backlog growth is mostly self-generated. First-contact demand rose only 4% (8,770 to 9,120). Split children rose from 240 to 3,710 and customer duplicates from 410 to 2,770. The reopen rate went from 6% to 23%, and the audit log rules out a reporting artifact. Agents moved from oldest-first picking (71% to 34%) to a quick-wins filter (41% of picks), and aged complex tickets tripled. Capacity was flat (38 to 37 FTE, hours nearly unchanged), and Payroll is a small share of volume. The quota gaming hypothesis is supported, so raising the quota is harmful and extra headcount is premature. Suspend the per-agent quota and classify the aged tickets. Engineering's bug backlog is unquantified.
